fields.statement: QA at 4a03cf7 with a built rhiza (go build to a scratch dir), REX_CONFIG pointed at a scratch init.lua and a fake rex first on PATH. First rex install wrote rhiza.lua (marker, launch_key ctrl+a a, BIN = the binary) and appended one require("rhiza") -- added by rhiza rex install line, keeping the owner's lines incl. trailing spaces; fake rex logged config reload. A second install reported written [] and cmp showed both files byte-identical. An edited launch_key survived a reinstall. uninstall removed rhiza.lua and cmp showed init.lua equal to the owner's original. With no init.lua, install created it and uninstall removed it again; a second uninstall says nothing to remove. A foreign rhiza.lua is refused (exit 3, next: --force). The written init.lua plus rhiza.lua loaded in luajit against a fake rex: bind ctrl+a>a rhiza_launch, whose run calls new_layer with flavor com.superlogical.terminal.shell running <BIN> tui launch, focus true. Real Rex config untouched.

QA at 4a03cf7 with a built rhiza on this repo's real model (RHIZA_ROOT/RUN unset). rhiza <op> --json and rhiza tui app <op> --once are byte-identical (cmp) for roadmap (19626 bytes), ready (14007 bytes) and slice with RHIZA_CHANGE=01M62JMSW4FH8RAWSQXHC7ZPND (18187 bytes); show/why/slice on handles not in the as-is view fail the same way (not_found, exit 4) in both. In a real Rex session (patched only to attach, see the qa finding) the roadmap modal showed the same JSON with the j/k scroll footer. Gap: tui app drops the global --change flag, so rhiza tui app slice --change <cs> --once fails (exit 2) where rhiza slice --change <cs> --json succeeds; reported as a minor finding.

QA at 4a03cf7 in real Rex: rex new a throwaway session running the built rhiza tui launch. The layer lists ready, roadmap, show, slice, why with summaries. Pressing down+enter on roadmap failed: 'rhiza: tui launch: rex session.view: stream is not attached to session ... (conflict, 409)' and no modal opened. cmd/rhiza/tui.go dials Rex but never calls session.attach, which rexuikit surface.New documents as required. A scratch build adding rex.Attach(ctx, session) after Dial opened a 'roadmap' block showing the roadmap app, so the fix is that one call. The fake-Rex unit tests pass because the fake does not enforce attachment.
